title: Shape Gallery
description: One chapter, eleven quests, one per shape: rounded, square, circle, diamond, hexagon, octagon, pentagon, gear, heart, tome and none.

It is the reference for the shape field. Every node is the same size and the same distance from its neighbours, so a difference you see between two of them is the shape and not the layout -- an exhibit that varies two things shows nothing.
The chapter is collapsed in the sidebar because it is a reference rather than a story: nobody reads it front to back, and a reader who wants it knows where it is.
